Title: TE-28056
Description: The Test Environment includes the following equipment: actual target (P0010452), a harness DAA CS 1.0 (P011389), a Linux based PC, a power supply source (MED0189), a DC power connector, ESD simulator system (EQT0102), power transformer isolator (EQ01947 & EQT0208), LISN (EQT0101), grounding cables, wooden table, horizontal coupling plane (HCP), 2 resistors 470KOhms, crocodile clips, and some banana cables.
